title: Destructive timeout and output-limit termination qualification
objective: Qualify the provider-private bounded executor's destructive failure paths using deterministic fixed inbox child modes: timeout and stdout/stderr output-limit termination must terminate the Job, verify zero active Job processes, distinguish verified termination from unverified termination, and return typed evidence without exposing external process authority.

include: fixed deterministic timeout qualification child mode
fixed deterministic stdout-limit qualification child mode
fixed deterministic stderr-limit qualification child mode
Job Object termination and active-process accounting
typed ProcessTimeout, OutputLimit, and TerminationUnverified results
exclude: configured workspace grants or ACL mutation

authority_delta.filesystem: Qualification-only explicit temporary root used as cwd; no configured workspace grant or ACL mutation
authority_delta.process: Private test-only fixed failure-mode executor; no external or MCP process authority
authority_delta.secrets: Fixed environment allowlist; no Cotra/tunnel secret inheritance

invariants: Failure fixtures are fixed provider-private modes and are not caller-selectable executable authority
Each child is AppContainer-contained and assigned to the kill-on-close Job before resume
Timeout termination closes the active Job and verifies zero active Job processes before returning ProcessTimeout
Output-limit termination closes the active Job and verifies zero active Job processes before returning OutputLimit
Any termination uncertainty returns TerminationUnverified and never a success result
Stdout and stderr limits remain independently enforced
No child environment or handle inheritance broadens beyond the SG-000009 allowlist
No network, PowerShell, ACL grant, browser/UI, elevation, approval, or process.spawn authority is added

acceptance.claim: Native Windows timeout fixture reaches its bounded deadline and returns typed ProcessTimeout only after zero active Job processes.
Native Windows stdout-limit fixture returns typed OutputLimit only after zero active Job processes.
Native Windows stderr-limit fixture returns typed OutputLimit only after zero active Job processes.
A deliberately indeterminate termination path returns TerminationUnverified rather than success.
Failure fixtures preserve AppContainer identity, pre-resume Job membership, fixed environment, and three-handle inheritance.
Existing SG-000009 fixed no-argument success fixture remains green.
Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, Jev, and Alibaba Open Code Review gates pass.

done_when: Timeout and output-limit destructive paths are merged with exact-head and post-merge verification, or a genuine Windows limitation is documented without weakening typed failure semantics.

canonical_evidence.jev: PASSED: implementation 15/15 hunks and closeout 5/5 hunks, zero findings, zero blocking findings
canonical_evidence.ocr: PASSED: exact-range delegation on implementation and closeout ranges
